overview_description.description: Purpose is a financial technology company and a collective of conscious consumers and businesses transforming finance into a force for good. Join us on our mission to build a more transparent, equitable and sustainable economy. We’re founded by a cross-disciplinary team with decades of combined experience across engineering, design and finance. We bring a design-led and impact-led philosophy to building financial products.
